candidates.prompt:
Generate ONE professional top-down Indian apartment floor plan: clean 2D orthographic drafting, black walls on white.
CONCEPT 01 of 04 - Balanced / symmetric: Mirror-symmetric flats either side of a central common lobby; one stair and lift at each end of the lobby.
Input image 1 is the deterministic layout and the primary structural reference: keep its flat boundaries, core, lifts, stairs, common lobby, room arrangement, doors and proportions.
Input images 2-3 are visual style and planning-language references only: never copy their flat count, geometry or text.
Priority: user requirements > deterministic layout > reference style.
EXACTLY 2 flats: FLAT 01 2BHK = 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, living, dining, kitchen, utility; FLAT 02 3BHK = 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, living, dining, kitchen, utility.
Common core: EXACTLY 2 lifts (square shafts with X), EXACTLY 2 stairs (treads with a centre divider), ONE shaded common lobby touching every flat entrance.
Entry in every flat: common lobby > entrance door > foyer > living/dining > bedrooms. The lobby never opens into a bedroom or bath.
Keep the architectural form natural: varied room proportions and articulated flat outlines; do not convert the layout into a rigid square grid.
English labels only, short and clear, as in image 1: FLAT 01, FLAT 02, 2BHK, 3BHK, LIVING, DINING, KITCHEN, BEDROOM, BATH, UTILITY, FOYER, LIFT, STAIR, LOBBY. No other text, no dimensions.
Do not add or remove flats, change the unit mix or the common core, or turn the project into a villa. No 3D, no perspective, no furniture, no watermark, no non-Latin text.

candidates.prompt: Deterministic apartment base plan rendered from schematic (2 flats, 2 lifts, 2 stairs, common lobby). Not generated by FLUX.

strengths: Clean symmetry in core circulation with dual lifts and stairs
Clear separation of public living areas from private bedrooms
Dedicated foyers for each apartment providing entry transition
Balanced layout fulfilling all 2BHK and 3BHK program requirements
concerns: Internal bathrooms rely heavily on mechanical ducting without direct exterior windows
Some secondary bedroom doors open directly onto the main living and dining circulation paths
Balcony placements are somewhat restricted to side elevations
evaluation.rationale: The plan successfully organizes two distinct residential units around a central vertical circulation core with dual lifts and stairs. Functional zoning is handled well with clear entry foyers, though some interior wet areas depend on service ducts for ventilation. Overall, the layout is efficient, balanced, and precisely meets the specified programmatic requirements.
